title: ADR-0087 upgrade-guide entries for the date-text verdicts name formulas and predicates only, not flow value envelopes
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQAXHSQEgnYyx9tstb

Filing gate: ① measured. Found in the #34451 dev round (PR #34654, open question 3). ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #34451
Suggested-grade: p3 — upgrade-guide text; the verdicts and their rewrites are already registered.

## What

PR #34654 lets the date-text verdicts reach flow value envelopes and declares its ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (already-registered formula-timestamp-date-only-refused, formula-date-text-call-refused, formula-date-subtraction-refused)`. Those three semantic entries' surface text names formulas and predicates (validation rules, field rules, flow conditions) only. An author whose flow stops registering because of an `update_record` / `create_record` field or an `assignment` value finds no upgrade-guide entry naming that site.

## Where

`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.*.ts`: the three entries named above. This touches `packages/spec/src`, so it lands through Tier H.

## Done when

Each of the three entries names flow value envelopes among its sites, with the same rewrite (`isoDate(addDays(record.<date field>, N))`).

Dedupe words: ADR-0087 semantic entry value envelope, formula-timestamp-date-only-refused surface, upgrade guide flow fields date-text.
